c=compile('x=7\ndef f(a,/,b=9,*,c=11): return a+b+c\n',"dynamic.py",'exec')
print(type(c).__name__,c.co_name,c.co_qualname,c.co_filename,c.co_firstlineno,c.co_argcount,len(c.co_freevars))
print(c.co_names is c.co_names)

c=compile('(lambda x=7: x+1)',"dynamic.py",'eval')
print(type(c).__name__,c.co_name,c.co_qualname,c.co_filename,c.co_firstlineno,c.co_argcount,len(c.co_freevars))
print(c.co_names is c.co_names)

c=compile('if True:\n 7\n',"dynamic.py",'single')
print(type(c).__name__,c.co_name,c.co_qualname,c.co_filename,c.co_firstlineno,c.co_argcount,len(c.co_freevars))
print(c.co_names is c.co_names)

c=compile(b'answer=7','file.py',"exec")
print(c.co_filename,c.co_name)

c=compile(b"# coding: utf-8\nname='caf\xc3\xa9'\n",'file.py',"exec")
print(c.co_filename,c.co_name)

c=compile(bytearray(b'x=7'),'file.py',"exec")
print(c.co_filename,c.co_name)

c=compile(memoryview(b'x=7'),'file.py',"exec")
print(c.co_filename,c.co_name)

c=compile('x=7\r\ny=9\r','file.py',"exec")
print(c.co_filename,c.co_name)

c=compile('x=7',b'file.py',"exec")
print(c.co_filename,c.co_name)

c=compile(mode="eval",filename="keyword.py",source="7+9",optimize=0,dont_inherit=True,flags=0)
print(c.co_filename,len(c.co_varnames))
print(compile("","empty.py","exec").co_name)
print(compile("7","","eval").co_filename=="")

a=compile("7","same.py","eval")
b=compile("7","same.py","eval")
print(a is b)

c=compile("def f():\n 'document'\n assert False\n return __debug__\n","opt.py","exec",optimize=-1)
fcode=c.co_consts[0]
# Locate the nested function without relying on optimizer constant placement.
for item in c.co_consts:
 if type(item) is type(c): fcode=item
print(fcode.co_name,fcode.co_consts[0])

c=compile("def f():\n 'document'\n assert False\n return __debug__\n","opt.py","exec",optimize=0)
fcode=c.co_consts[0]
# Locate the nested function without relying on optimizer constant placement.
for item in c.co_consts:
 if type(item) is type(c): fcode=item
print(fcode.co_name,fcode.co_consts[0])

c=compile("def f():\n 'document'\n assert False\n return __debug__\n","opt.py","exec",optimize=1)
fcode=c.co_consts[0]
# Locate the nested function without relying on optimizer constant placement.
for item in c.co_consts:
 if type(item) is type(c): fcode=item
print(fcode.co_name,fcode.co_consts[0])

c=compile("def f():\n 'document'\n assert False\n return __debug__\n","opt.py","exec",optimize=2)
fcode=c.co_consts[0]
# Locate the nested function without relying on optimizer constant placement.
for item in c.co_consts:
 if type(item) is type(c): fcode=item
print(fcode.co_name,"document" in fcode.co_consts)
